title: Additional text for sign subject to this section.
officialText: Additional descriptive text is permitted, provided such words are in sans serif letters and, where the word “EXIT” or the emergency symbol is required on such sign, such a descriptive text is no more than one-half as high as the word “EXIT” or the emergency exit symbol.
